The Indian 'Cockroach' protest movement has reignited amid anger at sweeping revisions to India's voting rolls, presenting yet another challenge to Modi. In this video, we're taking a look at the protests, what they're all about and why it's bad news for Modi.

📰 Too Long: https://toolong.news/
🎉 TLDR Party:  https://toolong.news/pages/tldr-party
📖 Read our Manifesto: https://tldrnews.co.uk/manifesto

Our mission is to explain news and politics in an impartial, efficient, and accessible way, balancing import and interest while fostering independent thought.

TLDR is a completely independent & privately owned media company that's not afraid to tackle the issues we think are most important. The channel is run by a small group of young people, with us hoping to pass on our enthusiasm for politics to other young people. We are primarily fan sourced with most of our funding coming from donations and ad revenue. No shady corporations, no one telling us what to say. We can't wait to grow further and help more people get informed. Help support us by subscribing, engaging and sharing. Thanks!

//////////////////////

Sources

First TLDR video on cockroach protest movement:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IILCtRP9UkI 

130 million names have been purged by SIR so far:
https://www.reuters.com/world/india/delhi-shuts-metro-stations-restricts-traffic-ahead-new-protest-against-election-2026-10-12/ 

Controversy in West Bengal:
 https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy51qg00dezo

SIR sparks protests:
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/06/world/asia/india-protests-voter-list-changes.html

Indian Express report on Election Commission:
https://indianexpress.com/article/express-exclusive/election-commission-sir-14-objections-gyanesh-kumar-sukhbir-singh-sandhu-vivek-joshi-10889737/ 

Delhi security crackdown:
https://www.dw.com/en/indian-authorities-crack-down-on-cockroach-protest-in-central-delhi/live-79624339 

Protesters, leaders, detained:
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/11/cockroach-party-leader-released-delhi-protests-second-day 

CJP demands to be able to hold protest:
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/delhi/24-hour-ultimatum-cjp-asks-delhi-police-to-fix-date-time-for-jantar-mantar-protest/articleshow/134884994.cms 

Opposition Congress party leads march to Supreme Court:
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/12/india-election-protests-delhi-police-shut-metro-stations-ahead-march 

Why this is a major challenge to Modi:
 https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/11/world/asia/india-crackdown-narendra-modi.html?eafs_enabled=false 
https://www.reuters.com/world/india/modis-three-pronged-challenge-2026-10-13/
